name: live-accessibility-overlay
description: Chrome extension that surfaces accessibility problems on the live page, in context.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:unit:firefox-api && npm run test:ext
scripts.verify-package: node tools/package.mjs && rm -rf /tmp/lao-verify && mkdir -p /tmp/lao-verify && unzip -q dist/live-accessibility-overlay-chrome-*.zip -d /tmp/lao-verify && LAO_EXT_DIR=/tmp/lao-verify node test/extension.mjs
